scope.method: Five native node.screenshot({scale:1}) captures visually inspected; three named base icons read for exact stroke colors.

checks.name: 回复与阅读 / 01
observations: White cards on a neutral light gray board; black body copy and gray secondary copy.
Primary stop buttons are black with white labels.
Athena mark and compact activity icon retain restrained blue/teal color; no color spill into body copy.

checks.name: 提问与结构化回答 / 01
observations: White form surfaces and neutral gray selected/disabled states.
Selected controls and emphasis borders are black; primary confirmation buttons are black.
Compact Bot icons remain blue; field values, dates, helper copy and error explanation are neutral and readable.

checks.name: MCP 交互面板 / 01
observations: White panels, light gray embedded surfaces and neutral skeletons.
Usage value 184620, dates, chart bars and result rows remain neutral black/gray.
Blue icon accents remain restricted to compact Bot/activity glyphs; primary filter control is black.

checks.name: Flow / 04 工具执行
observations: White conversation column with subtle neutral side panels and selected navigation.
Athena logo, Bot and file icons retain color; labels, paths, command output and task data remain neutral.
Black stop control; green permission check stays a compact status signal.
No visible color-driven clipping, unreadable text or misplaced focus emphasis.

checks.name: 富产物与结构化提问 / 01
observations: White media surfaces with neutral waveform, chart, timeline and player controls.
Playback buttons and active progress are black; metadata and numeric values remain neutral.
Generated-state green checks are confined to icons; no body or chart data is accidentally colored.

preview.provenance: Native inline PNG returned by Figma node.screenshot; decoded directly without image alteration.

limitations: Review covers the five requested representative frames and three named icon components, not all 175 semantic states.
Interactive focus behavior and runtime execution were not exercised.
